english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for an inherent weakness or disadvantage.
Use this when the drawback is an inherent flaw or shortcoming of a person or thing.
Use this when the limitation is a defect or shortcoming that reduces usefulness or value.
Use this for a personal character failing or shortcoming rather than responsibility for an event.
Use 缺點 specifically when the weakness is an inadequacy or personal fault rather than a vulnerable point.

examples.english: The biggest disadvantage of this plan is that it’s too expensive.
examples.traditional: 呢個方案最大嘅缺點係太貴。
examples.jyutping: ni1 go3 fong1 on3 zeoi3 daai6 ge3 kyut3 dim2 hai6 taai3 gwai3

examples.english: The drawback of this phone is that the battery runs out quickly.
examples.traditional: 呢部手機嘅缺點係電池好快冇電。
examples.jyutping: ni1 bou6 sau2 gei1 ge3 kyut3 dim2 hai6 din6 ci4 hou2 faai3 mou5 din6

examples.english: The biggest limitation of this design is that it isn't practical enough.
examples.traditional: 呢個設計最大嘅缺點係唔夠實用。
examples.jyutping: ni1 go3 cit3 gai3 zeoi3 daai6 ge3 kyut3 dim2 hai6 m4 gau3 sat6 jung6

examples.english: His biggest fault is that he is too stubborn.
